speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the specific location and nature of your flank pain, and how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any pain or burning sensation when you urinate, or have you noticed any changes in the color or frequency of your urine? I also need to know if you have a history of kidney stones or urinary tract infections.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any joint pain, swelling, or blood in your urine after starting the cephalexin? I also need to know if you have noticed any swelling in your legs or face.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of antibiotic use followed by a rash and subsequent fever and flank pain, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis_with_microscopy.
